This method can be invoked many times, with modifications in between
where each new call returns a fresh copy of the current header values.
items.translation: 此方法可多次调用，中间可进行修改，每次新调用都会返回当前头部值的副本。

items.source:

(followed up with an assertion) or where an accessor will be created otherwise.
items.translation: 这是针对以下情况：强烈预期存在访问器（随后会进行断言），或者否则将创建该访问器。

However when this is set to true, the returned (underlying) MessageHeaders instance remains mutable. To make further modifications continue to use the same accessor instance or re-obtain it via:

items.translation:
然而，当此值设置为 `true` 时，返回的（底层）`MessageHeaders` 实例仍然可修改。若要继续进行修改，请继续使用相同的访问器实例或通过以下方式重新获取：
MessageHeaderAccessor.getAccessor(Message, Class)

items.source: This method always returns the same MessageHeaders instance if invoked multiples times. To obtain a copy of the underlying headers, use toMessageHeaders() or toMap() instead.
items.translation: 此方法如果多次调用，始终返回相同的 `MessageHeaders` 实例。若要获取底层 headers 的副本，请使用toMessageHeaders()或toMap()代替。

items.source: Below is a workflow to initialize headers via MessageHeaderAccessor, or one of its subclasses, then create a Message, and then re-obtain the accessor possibly from a different component:
items.translation: 下面是通过 `MessageHeaderAccessor` 或其子类初始化标头，然后创建 `Message`，随后可能从不同组件重新获取访问器的流程：

items.source: In order for the above to work, all participating components must use MessageHeaders to create, access, or modify headers, or otherwise getAccessor(Message, Class) will return null. Below is a workflow that shows how headers are created and left mutable, then modified possibly by a different component, and finally made immutable perhaps before the possibility of being accessed on a different thread:
items.translation: 为了使上述内容生效，所有参与组件必须使用MessageHeaders来创建、访问或修改头部信息；否则，getAccessor(Message, Class)将返回 null。 下面是一个工作流程示例，展示了如何创建头部信息并保持其可变性，随后可能由不同组件进行修改，最后可能在跨线程访问之前将其设为不可变：

items.source: Unless setLeaveMutable(boolean) was set to true, after this call, the headers are immutable and this accessor can no longer modify them.
items.translation: 除非在调用此方法之前，setLeaveMutable(boolean) 已设置为 true，否则在此调用之后，头部将变为不可变，且此访问器将无法再对其进行修改。

items.source: When modifications are complete use setImmutable() to prevent further changes. The intended use case for this mechanism is initialization of a Message within a single thread.
items.translation: 完成修改后，请使用 `setImmutable()` 防止进一步更改。此机制的预期使用场景是在单个线程中初始化一个 `Message`。

items.source: This operation will overwrite any existing values. Use copyHeadersIfAbsent(Map) to avoid overwriting values.
items.translation: 此操作将覆盖任何现有值。使用 copyHeadersIfAbsent(Map) 来避免覆盖值。

items.source: By default, this is set to false.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为false。

items.source: If the provided value is null, the header will be removed.
items.translation: 如果提供的值为null，则头信息将被移除。

items.source: This operation will not overwrite any existing values.
items.translation: 此操作将 不会 覆盖任何现有值。

items.source:
As the name suggests, array may contain simple matching patterns for header
names. Supported pattern styles are: "xxx*", "*xxx", "*xxx*" and "xxx*yyy".
items.translation: 顾名思义，数组可以包含用于匹配标头名称的简单模式。支持的模式样式包括："xxx*"、"*xxx"、"*xxx*" 和 "xxx*yyy"。

items.source: This is for cases when a full message may not have been created yet.
items.translation: 这是针对完整消息尚未创建的情况。

items.source:
This is for cases where a header needs to be updated in generic code
while preserving the accessor type for downstream processing.
items.translation: 这是用于在通用代码中更新头信息，同时保留下游处理所需的访问器类型的情况。

items.source: By default, when getMessageHeaders() is called, "this" MessageHeaderAccessor instance can no longer be used to modify the underlying message headers. However if setLeaveMutable(boolean) is used, this method is necessary to indicate explicitly when the MessageHeaders instance should no longer be modified.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当调用getMessageHeaders()时，"this"MessageHeaderAccessor实例将不能再用于修改底层消息头。然而，如果使用setLeaveMutable(boolean)，则此方法是必要的，以明确指示何时不应再修改MessageHeaders实例。

items.source: By default, when getMessageHeaders() is called, "this" MessageHeaderAccessor instance can no longer be used to modify the underlying message headers and the returned MessageHeaders is immutable.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当调用getMessageHeaders()时，"this"MessageHeaderAccessor实例将无法再用于修改底层消息头，且返回的MessageHeaders是不可变的。

items.source: A variation of getAccessor(org.springframework.messaging.Message, Class) with a MessageHeaders instance instead of a Message.
items.translation: `getAccessor(org.springframework.messaging.Message, Class)` 的一个变体，使用 `MessageHeaders` 实例而不是 `Message`。

items.source: By default, when getMessageHeaders() is called, "this" MessageHeaderAccessor instance can no longer be used to modify the underlying message headers.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当调用getMessageHeaders()时，"this"MessageHeaderAccessor实例将不能再用于修改底层消息头。
